}

6.可通过登录UI验证
7.防倒卖，请在登录UI界面输入作者名：tlyanyu

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);

    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var document = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var preElements = document.select('div#content-section.content-section > pre');
if (preElements.isEmpty()) {
    result = '未找到 div#content-section.content-section > pre 元素';
} else {
    var preElement = preElements.first();
    preElement.select('b font[size=4]').remove();
    var innerHtml = preElement.html();
    function convertHtmlToPlainTextWithLineBreaks(html) {
        var text = html;
        text = text.replaceAll(" ", " ");
        text = text.replaceAll("(?i)<p[^>]*><\\/p>", "\n");
        text = text.replaceAll("(?i)<p[^>]*>(.*?)<\\/p>", "\n$1\n");
        text = text.replaceAll("(?i)<br\\s*\\/?>", "\n");
        text = text.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", "");
        text = text.replaceAll("\\n{3,}", "\n\n");
        return text.trim();
    }
    var plainText = convertHtmlToPlainTextWithLineBreaks(innerHtml);
    result = plainText;
}
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var links=doc.select('pre a[href*="threadview"]');
var list=[];
var pdf=0;
if(links.size()>0){
var firstNext=links.get(links.size()-1).text();
var nm=firstNext.match(/([0-9０-９]+)[-–—]/);
if(nm)pdf=parseInt(nm[1].replace(/[０-９]/g,function(c){return String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0)-0xFEE0)}))-1;
}
var m=result.match(/【[^】]+】/);
var title=m?m[0]:'第1章';
var cn=pdf>0?title+'（1-'+pdf+'）':title;
var selfA=doc.createElement('a');
selfA.attr('href',baseUrl);
selfA.text(cn);
list.push(selfA);
for(var i=links.size()-1;i>=0;i--){list.push(links.get(i))}
result=list
</js>
